people.bio: Founder of Rigpa; Tibetan teacher (Nyingma tulku) whose books reached millions; stepped back in 2017 after misconduct allegations, died 2019.
people.name: Sogyal Rinpoche

people.bio: Head of the Shambhala lineage (son of Chögyam Trungpa); stepped back from teaching duties in 2018 after misconduct claims and investigation.
people.name: Sakyong Mipham Rinpoche

people.bio: Founder of White Plum Asanga and ZCLA (d. 1995); admitted alcoholism and sexual misconduct 1983; lineage continues with published reforms.
people.name: Taizan Maezumi Roshi

people.bio: Founder of Kripalu (1972); resigned 1994 after admitting affairs; federal litigation followed; Kripalu restructured without him.
people.name: Yogi Amrit Desai
people.source: Orlando Sentinel 1994 + Kripalu timeline + Justia opinion
